# Piyush Rajput

> Computer Science and Engineering student at Karnavati University in Ahmedabad, specializing in AI/ML. Exploring AI, interactive software, browser-based 3D, robotics, and embedded systems.

From curiosity to creation. This portfolio distinguishes built work, prototypes, proposed architecture, coursework, exploration, and current learning. Signal Run is an optional original portfolio interaction.

## Public information

- [Portfolio](/): The Builder's Mind, an editorial portfolio with a playable intermission.
- [About](/about.md): Biography, verified education, interests, and public profiles.
- [Education](/education.md): Academic stages, confirmed programme details, coursework, and interests.
- [Projects](/projects.md): Accurate project records and development status.
- [Skills](/skills.md): Hands-on experience distinguished from learning and exploration.
- [Full public portfolio](/llms-full.txt): Detailed text representation.

## Project resources

- [Tridix](/projects/tridix/): Built. Physics, beyond the flat page. A browser-based learning experience that brings concepts into three dimensions.
- [LegalOne](/projects/legalone/): Hackathon project. A conversational starting point for Indian legal information, explored with team Binary Bandits.
- [Meghdoot AI](/projects/meghdoot-ai/): SIH team project. A flood-detection project explored across an app, web application, and website for Smart India Hackathon.
- [BRTS Bus Route System](/projects/brts/): Terminal prototype. From command line to interface: working with bus-route information using Python and MySQL.
- [Smart Calendar](/projects/smart-calendar/): Exploring. A physical student calendar concept: dates, tasks, reminders, and a little more connection to everyday life.
- [Autonomous Driving Robot](/projects/autonomous-robot/): Architecture exploration. Exploring the bridge from perception to movement, through a proposed two-board autonomous robot architecture.
